text: Good morning! Are you the new Third Officer?
Yes, good morning. I'm Diego Martínez.
I'm Rolando, the bosun. Welcome! The taxi stopped at the bow, so we have a little walk.
say: I'm Rolando, the bo'sun. Welcome! The taxi stopped at the bow, so we have a little walk.

text: The gangway is on the port side, aft.
Sorry, can you say that again?
Port side. Aft. Near the stern. We're port side alongside, so this side is port.
OK. So aft is towards the stern, and forward is towards the bow?
Exactly. Bow is forward, stern is aft.
She's very long. What's that, in the middle?
Amidships? That's the manifold. You'll see it a lot.
And the starboard side is the other side, facing the water.
say: And the starb'd side is the other side, facing the water.

text: That's right. Here we are. The gangway. Watch your step!
